conditions: Select an application-owned API with requestedAccessTokenVersion=2; the token endpoint version alone does not determine the access-token version. Use resource-specific v2 metadata, trusted signing keys, allowed algorithms, exact issuer, API client ID audience and lifetime validation. Reject Graph, ID, foreign-resource and v1 tokens in this selected scope. Actual external-tenant metadata and claims remain untested. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/access-tokens.

Require the expected external-directory tid, registered machine azp and explicit app-only identity policy. Select the optional idtyp=app claim and reject missing or user values; do not infer app-only identity solely from an absent scp or present roles claim. Configure and verify this claim before approval. Signed client identity does not grant access to application data.

Require the API's assigned application roles for each operation, then independently authorize the machine against application-owned organization/resource records. The external-directory tid is not a customer organization ID; reject missing, unknown or cross-organization access. Human group membership, email, user roles and upstream federation are not machine permissions.

Entra can issue role-less app-only tokens for ACL-based APIs. This selected app-role proposal must reject them; enable assignment requirements and verify role enforcement independently. A successful exchange, decoded JWT or /.default request is not authorization. ACL-only authorization is outside scope. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-oauth2-client-creds-grant-flow.

Credential rotation, consent/role removal, service offboarding and cached-token expiry need separate fail-closed tests. Do not promise immediate rejection of issued access tokens. No API validation, claim configuration, isolation or revocation was tested; residency, SCIM, human MFA and customer membership are not inherited. AuthWeave authentication and its synthetic evaluator remain unchanged.

evidence.summary: Microsoft documents API audience, tenant, subject and app-only identity checks. OPTIONAL is an unreviewed custom API v2 app-role proposal, conditional on external-tenant M2M add-on setup and independent resource authorization; no live enforcement or isolation is established.

conditions: Use a standard-mode External ID external tenant with the M2M Premium add-on explicitly selected. This is a paid comparison scope, not Basic-only free MAU, a trial entitlement, a workforce tenant or Azure AD B2C. Client-secret and certificate M2M are documented; this proposal selects only a confidential backend with a shared secret.

Send grant_type=client_credentials, client_id, a URL-encoded client_secret and scope=<API application ID URI>/.default in an HTTPS form body to the selected external tenant's trusted token endpoint; choose client_secret_post only. Never expose secrets in source, browser/mobile bundles, URLs or logs. Certificate assertions, federated credentials, Basic and mTLS are outside scope. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-oauth2-client-creds-grant-flow.

Expose least-privilege application roles on the custom API and assign/admin-consent them to the client. Delegated user permissions do not apply. /.default targets one resource and the preconfigured grant, not a dynamic per-request subset of individual roles. External-tenant registration, assignment and consent are prerequisites, not completed setup. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-oauth2-client-creds-grant-flow.

Use the returned access_token as Bearer within its validated expiry; cache it safely and obtain a new token through client_credentials when required. This selected grant has no refresh token, human login, ID Token, redirect, BFF session or customer membership. Token acquisition and response behavior are untested. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-oauth2-client-creds-grant-flow.

M2M add-on charges are transaction-based and separate from Basic MAU. A free interactive-user allowance does not include free machine authentication. Exact rates, quotas, subscription linkage and tenant entitlement remain unverified; no zero-cost production promise. Do not enable billing or make paid test exchanges without a separate owner decision. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/external-id/external-identities-pricing.

Cloud sources are mutable and observation-dated, not release-pinned. Do not copy generic workforce/common endpoints or assume customer user-flow login settings configure machine access. No account, tenant, subscription, application, secret, app-role grant, payment or live call was created. The six earlier Entra scopes and their observedAt values stay separate.

evidence.summary: The external-tenant overview documents client-credentials M2M with a client secret or certificate and requires the M2M Premium add-on. SUPPORTED is a conditional paid-add-on documentation proposal, not Basic-only free entitlement or tested integration.
